raw_output: Michael's perception and management of job stress evolved significantly over time. Initially, he felt overwhelmed by his new job, which he found isolating and stressful due to the distance from home and a falling out with a colleague. He struggled with anxiety, loneliness, and physical health issues, including back pain. However, with the support of his supporter, he began to explore ways to cope, including reconnecting with old hobbies like playing guitar and seeking out community groups. He also started to prioritize self-care and meditation to manage his anxiety. When he accepted a new job offer closer to home with better pay and flexible hours, he felt hopeful but also anxious, reflecting on past experiences and learning from them. This time, he made a conscious effort to set clearer boundaries, build better relationships, and focus on self-care, which gave him a sense of confidence and momentum.
